nar4_001: A soft night rain pattered beyond the wooden lattice window, while warm yellow paper lanterns cast a gentle glow over the table in the izakaya's half-private booth.
nar4_002: The aromas of grilled chicken skewers and salt-roasted ginkgo nuts mingled with the warmth of sake, slowly spreading between the narrow wooden tables.
nar4_003: Narumi Jinguji was not wearing the plain glasses she occasionally used for reading papers at the hospital, nor her immaculate white coat. A fitted, deep burgundy knit dress traced her mature figure. Resting her cheek on one hand, she regarded him through lightly tipsy eyes with a languor rarely seen in the clinic.
nar4_004: "Here, Chief Surgeon Sakaguchi. This one is on me."
nar4_005: She lifted the sake flask and unhurriedly filled Ryuji Sakaguchi's shallow cup, her fingertip seeming to brush the back of his hand by accident.
nar4_007: "Why so formal all of a sudden? I thought tonight was just an ordinary dinner out."
nar4_008: Narumi took a small sip, leaving a faint sheen on the rim of the porcelain cup.
nar4_009: "I've called you 'Dr. Sakaguchi' all week at the hospital. On the rare Sunday night when I don't have to read charts or listen to Aqua go on about her data model, of course I deserve a proper treat."
nar4_010: The corners of her eyes lifted as she appraised him with an enigmatic smile.
nar4_011: "Or have you grown so used to seeing me in scrubs, Dr. Sakaguchi, that you don't recognize me in a different outfit?"
nar4_012: "I was only thinking that, dressed like this, you're even harder to look away from than you are in the surgical office."
nar4_013: Narumi laughed and leaned slightly forward, the neckline of her dress forming an elegant curve.
nar4_014: "Such a sweet talker. It seems your overseas training taught more than how to hold a scalpel."
nar4_015: They chatted over several small dishes, moving from the latest troublesome family in the outpatient clinic to the laptop Aqua had nearly ruined with sandwich mayonnaise. The mood was relaxed and familiar.
nar4_016: After several rounds of drinks, Ryuji recalled a name he had seen on the day's roster and asked casually.
nar4_017: "Come to think of it, Nurse Nanase wasn't scheduled today either, was she? I assumed the two of you often went out together when you had weekends off."
nar4_018: The smile on Narumi's face abruptly faded.
nar4_019: She set down her cup, narrowed her beautiful eyes, and deliberately glared at him with feigned displeasure in her voice.
nar4_020: "Talking about another woman while you're on a date with one?"
nar4_023: At the sight of him suddenly at a loss for words, Narumi could no longer contain the mischief in her eyes. She burst into laughter and lightly tapped the table with one fingertip.
nar4_024: "I'm teasing. It was only a joke. Look how nervous you got."
nar4_025: She picked up her cup again, rubbing the warm porcelain with her thumb as genuine warmth and concern gradually entered her expression.
nar4_026: "Ren went shopping with some of the younger nurses today. That girl... She may always look gentle and obedient, but you saw her at the negotiating table. When it is truly time to decide, she has a mind of her own more than anyone."
nar4_028: "When she told that person, 'It was my own decision,' she really was admirable."
nar4_029: Narumi sighed softly, her eyes holding the concern of an older sister and a longtime partner.
nar4_030: "Yes. She stopped being a little girl who needed me to decide for her a long time ago. Even knowing that she can make her own decisions, after all these years I still can't help worrying about her."
nar4_031: Then Narumi raised her eyes and looked directly into Ryuji's.
nar4_032: "So, Dr. Sakaguchi, let me make one thing clear in advance. If you truly decide to pursue Ren someday, that is between the two of you. But if you ever treat her poorly or make her shed so much as half a tear, I will not let you off."
nar4_033: "So, Dr. Sakaguchi, let me tell you this to your face. Ren has chosen you, and that is her decision. But if you ever treat her poorly or make her shed so much as half a tear, I will not let you off."
nar4_034: Her tone was as calm as if she were discussing the weather, yet left no doubt that she meant every word.

choice_nar4_034_b: (Meet her gaze with a wry smile.) "After seeing Dr. Jinguji negotiate in the director's office, I would never dare ignore that warning."
nar4_035: Ryuji instinctively tightened his grip on the cup.
nar4_036: "...I really was only asking how she was doing."

nar4_040: "After seeing Dr. Jinguji negotiate in the director's office, I would never dare ignore that warning."
nar4_041: Narumi saw the way he had tensed for an instant and smiled, her eyes curving with amusement.
nar4_042: "Your face turned so serious just now, yet you're still pretending otherwise. Why do you get nervous the moment I tease you? How cute."
nar4_043: Narumi drained the last of her sake, a faint flush coloring both cheeks.
nar4_044: She set down her cup and gently brushed Ryuji's calf with her toes beneath the small table, fixing him with a direct gaze.
nar4_045: "All right, enough about other people. How are you planning to keep me company for the rest of tonight, Dr. Sakaguchi?"
nar4_046: The rain had stopped by the time they left the izakaya. A damp evening breeze swept through the neon-lit intersection, carrying the coolness of night.
nar4_047: They walked side by side to the crossroads. As Ryuji stopped to ask which way led to her apartment, Narumi reached out and naturally linked her arm through his.
nar4_048: The softness of her chest pressed against the crook of his arm through the thin knit fabric, bringing with it the scent of roses and faint sake.
nar4_049: Narumi looked toward a quietly lit boutique hotel not far away, a smile curling at her lips.
nar4_050: "Dr. Sakaguchi, I don't particularly feel like going back to my lonely room tonight."
nar4_051: She turned toward him, her lightly tipsy yet lucid eyes studying him from close range, and lowered her voice.
nar4_052: "Will you come sit with me over there?"
nar4_053: Ryuji looked at her lips, now only inches away.
nar4_055: Narumi laughed softly. Her fingers slid down his forearm until they intertwined with his.
nar4_056: "Two small flasks of sake aren't enough to get me drunk. I know exactly what I'm doing, Ryuji Sakaguchi. What about you? Do you dare come with me?"
nar4_057: Ryuji asked no more questions. He clasped her warm fingers and led her through the hotel entrance.
nar4_058: The soft click of the door closing and locking sounded unusually clear in the quiet entryway.
nar4_059: Before Ryuji could reach for the room's main light, Narumi turned beneath the single dim wall lamp and raised both arms around his neck.
nar4_060: Warm, soft lips carrying the lingering taste of sake met his.
nar4_061: Her kiss was practiced and composed. Her tongue deftly parted his lips, and a barely audible hum escaped with her breath.
nar4_062: "Mm... I've wanted to do this ever since I watched you drinking at the izakaya..."

nar4_085: Ryuji held her smooth shoulder and looked down at her relaxed, contented expression.

nar4_097: "It is that simple. I wanted you, and I wanted to hold you, so I did. What, is Chief Surgeon Sakaguchi dissatisfied with that reason?"
nar4_098: Ryuji laughed and tightened his arms around her.
nar4_100: Monday morning at Hoshimi Hospital was as busy and orderly as ever.
nar4_101: When Ryuji returned to the surgical office after morning handover, Narumi was already at her desk in plain glasses, intently reviewing the preoperative assessment for the afternoon's abdominal-wall hernia repair.
nar4_102: Every button of her white coat was fastened with impeccable precision, and her long hair was neatly tied back. Even the faint mark still lingering on her neck from the previous night was completely hidden beneath her collar.
nar4_103: Ryuji walked over to her desk.
nar4_105: Narumi looked up, met his eyes calmly and naturally, and offered a standard professional smile.
nar4_106: "Good morning, Dr. Sakaguchi. Perfect timing. The repeat coagulation panel for the patient in bed three just came back. Take a look."
nar4_107: There were no lingering, suggestive looks, no shyness after becoming intimate, and no special treatment.
nar4_108: She picked up her red-and-blue pencil and crisply indicated two details on the lab report and preoperative plan.
nar4_109: "The patient stopped anticoagulants two hours later than planned last night. The current INR is barely within the safe range, but your preoperative plan lists only conventional gelatin sponge as backup for bleeding in the preperitoneal space. To be safe, I suggest having the scrub nurse prepare an additional bipolar cautery set and absorbable hemostatic gauze."
nar4_110: Ryuji looked down and checked the figures.
nar4_111: "You're right. I overlooked that. Add what you suggested."
nar4_112: Narumi nodded, closed the chart after signing her review, and handed it back to him.
nar4_113: "Everything else is fine. I'm going to make rounds on the ward. I'll see you in the operating room this afternoon."
nar4_114: Watching her leave the office with the chart held in her arms, composed and capable, Ryuji remained where he was with a subtle sense of confusion.
nar4_115: She was clearly neither angry nor deliberately distancing herself from him. Yet compared with the woman who had whispered, 'I simply like you,' beside his ear in a hotel bed the night before, Dr. Jinguji was being almost excessively professional.
nar4_116: It was not until half past noon, after lunch, that Ryuji encountered Narumi again around a corridor corner.
nar4_117: She carried two warm cans of black coffee. Seeing no one nearby, she slipped one into his hand and murmured.
nar4_118: "The breeze is pleasant up there. If you have a moment, come have coffee with me on the roof."
nar4_119: Afternoon sunlight covered the open hospital roof. A breeze stirred the chain-link fence, carrying the distant noise of the city.
nar4_120: Narumi leaned against the rooftop railing, opened her can, and took a small sip of warm coffee.
nar4_121: Hearing the rooftop door open behind her, she turned. At last, her eyes held the same teasing intimacy as the night before.
